claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: The witness identified a three-tier design console, which corresponds to the PS4 Pro.
The witness report states controllers were not shown.
The witness observed significant dust and surface scratches.
A photo of the warranty seal is missing.
Requires a video of the console running a game to verify fan noise and stability.
Functional state of ports was not shown.
The receipt was not shown in the report.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the warranty seals on the back of the console.
A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive

risks.proof: A screenshot of the System Storage settings menu.
A photo of the front and back of the controller showing the Sony logo and sticker.
A video showing the console successfully logging into the PlayStation Store.

proof_requests: Photo of the warranty seals on the back of the PS4 Pro.
Screenshot of the 'Storage' and 'System Information' (for software version) menus.
Video of the console running a game to check for noise and disc drive functionality.
response.reason: The PS4 Pro is identified by the witness, but it must be priced at its worst case due to visible dust, scratches, and the absence of proof for the controller and functional state.
